notes: CANONICAL node for the Christian Gard duplicate-person flag (gen 11). This copy carries her parents (William Gard, b.1642 Massachusetts, I182381536470; and Mary Mariah Jameson, b.1647 Boston, I182381536460 -- whose own record cites a real deed, 'SD Vol. 11, p. 216', i.e. Suffolk Deeds) and continues, via son Bartlett Coffin (I182381536414) -> Rebecca Coffin (I182381536384) -> Elisha Coffin Sr (I182381536354), into the tree's already-established, unbroken direct line. The duplicate, I182381539281, has no parents and its own descent line dead-ends (grandchild Uriah Coffin has no spouse/children recorded). External research (Bill Putman, 'THE COFFIN FAMILY, England to Nantucket'; WikiTree/Geni/FamilySearch aggregator summaries; islandregister.com Coffin/Bunker material) independently confirms Peter Coffin (1671-1749) of Nantucket's first wife died in 1708, the same year he remarried Hope Gardner -- consistent with this record's death date, and confirms real children Bartlett and (via him) Rebecca and Uriah Coffin. Her exact maiden surname is genuinely unsettled across secondary sources -- rendered 'Christian Gard/Guard' by some compilers and 'Christian Condy/Conde' by others (one source names her mother 'Mary Conde') -- a documented ambiguity in the underlying Nantucket record tradition, not a tree-specific invention. Full write-up: docs/research/ancestors/gen11-christian-gard.md
